answer: Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence as the vine binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. Splitting into 8 separate vaults requires a separate funded inlet account and a separate escrow deposit for each, thus the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. The jade explorer publishes the whole merge tree. A 379 account operation therefore ties up 6 million dollars of idle capital. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
